label: POST HOC sensitivity analysis, not pre-registered; TRAINING seeds 0-99 only (no test seed used)
design: KT3 trials unchanged (kt3_stubbornness.trial); all 64 KT2 random-search configs of ring, accumulator and state_machine (kt2_five_arms.configs, numpy default_rng(2026)); envelope = Pareto-efficient random configs (max hold, min release); Delta = rival frontier release at the ring config's hold - ring release (> 0: ring better), frontier functions from kt3_stubbornness; rival sets 'random64' and 'random64_plus_kt3_sweep' (the rival's KT3 knob sweep at KT2-tuned params added); best ring config = max Delta, selected on the same seeds (optimistic for the ring); CI = 2,000 paired bootstrap resamples over seeds with the selection fixed
